summary: Phase 4 frontend testing of ApplyPilot complete. All three features (#1 Job URL import, #13 Shareable resume link, #14 Word export) work end-to-end with no functional issues. SEED localStorage approach via Playwright context.add_init_script was required (setting localStorage after page load races zustand persist hydration).
critical_code_review_comments: lib/share.ts uses deprecated unescape()/escape(); functional but consider TextEncoder for future cleanliness.
/share page uses window.location.hash inside useEffect; an initial 'Loading…' state is shown briefly which is fine but could flicker on slow devices.

lib/jobUrl.ts truncates JD to 12000 chars in importFromUrl (good safety); meta extraction sends 6000 chars to AI (reasonable). No exposed error if AI meta call fails - silent fallback is intentional and acceptable.
test_credentials: SEED localStorage applypilot_v4 with Gemini API key (as provided in request).
seed_data_creation: Used context.add_init_script to seed localStorage BEFORE page scripts run. Setting localStorage after navigation races zustand persist hydration and can cause 'Resume not found'. Important note for next testing agent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: CRITICAL seeding tip: zustand persist (lib/store.ts) hydrates on first script load. If you setItem AFTER page load and reload, it works, BUT if you setItem then immediately navigate to a route that reads the data on first render, the page may show empty state. Safest pattern: use playwright context.add_init_script() with the JSON seed before any goto(). The actual /share encoding works correctly with base64url of JSON.stringify({p:profile,t:templateId}).
rca of the issue: No bug found. All Phase 4 features working. Initial test runs failed because localStorage seeding via post-navigation page.evaluate() races zustand persist hydration; fixed by using context.add_init_script() which guarantees seeding before page scripts execute.
